Risk Title & Description: Automated Bot Order Spam on Public Checkout Endpoint
Compensating Controls Implemented: Implemented hidden honeypot field (companyUrl), 1.2s rapid submission check, and input length sanitization on CheckoutPage.jsx.
Post-Release Action & Recommendation: Deploy Firebase App Check with reCAPTCHA Enterprise on Firebase console to verify client authenticity.

Risk Title & Description: Administrative Authorization Reliant on Firestore Document Reads
Compensating Controls Implemented: Rules strictly check /databases/$(database)/documents/admins/$(request.auth.uid).isActive == true; arbitrary writes to /admins blocked.
Post-Release Action & Recommendation: Migrate administrative privileges to Firebase Auth Custom Claims (token.admin == true) set via secure Cloud Function.

Risk Title & Description: Transactional Email Delivery via Webhook Parameter Payload
Compensating Controls Implemented: Added deep payload sanitization (length truncations, string casts) and 10s AbortController timeout in emailService.js. Non-blocking order save in Firestore.
Post-Release Action & Recommendation: Transition from Google Apps Script to authenticated enterprise transactional email API (SendGrid, Resend, or AWS SES).

Compensating Controls Implemented: npm overrides lock vulnerable transitive dependencies (nth-check ^2.1.1, postcss ^8.4.32); production build compiles cleanly without warnings.
Post-Release Action & Recommendation: Plan architectural migration from react-scripts to Vite 5+ with React 18/19 for faster builds and modern ESM toolchain.

Risk Title & Description: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) from Aspect Ratio Shifts in Image Delivery
Compensating Controls Implemented: Added explicit width and height dimension attributes (width=400, height=320/384) to all catalog image cards in Gallery, Seasonal, Cupcakes, Cookies, Catering.
Post-Release Action & Recommendation: Implement responsive srcset and WebP/AVIF picture elements for adaptive viewport delivery on 2G/3G connections.

Risk Title & Description: Degraded Mobile Network Handling During Order Placement
Compensating Controls Implemented: Implemented navigator.onLine offline check in CheckoutPage.jsx to prevent stalled submissions and preserve cart items with actionable user alerts.
Post-Release Action & Recommendation: Implement offline order queuing in IndexedDB with background service worker synchronization when connection is re-established.

Risk Title & Description: Search Engine Crawler Discovery of Newly Published Catalog Products
Compensating Controls Implemented: public/sitemap.xml catalogs all canonical routes; public/robots.txt references sitemap; Vercel rewrites bypass static XML assets.
Post-Release Action & Recommendation: Submit sitemap.xml to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools upon production deployment to expedite indexation.

Risk Title & Description: Absence of Centralized Error Tracking in Production
Compensating Controls Implemented: Implemented GlobalErrorBoundary in App.js catching runtime exceptions with a branded recovery UI and reload trigger.
Post-Release Action & Recommendation: Integrate Sentry or LogRocket client-side error monitoring to capture unhandled runtime exceptions in real time.
